links.label: Former middle-school deskmates bound by a childhood debt over a keepsake box
links.evidence: Years ago, before he was sent to the countryside, Fei Ni had lent him 1.5 yuan—most of her lunch money—in exchange for a precious metal box he left in her care.

links.label: Cares for the comatose hero, hoping it will earn her a university recommendation
links.evidence: She stepped forward and volunteered to care for the hero until his recovery, a gesture Ms. Xu highly praised as a display of true proletarian spirit.

links.label: Marries him in a fake arrangement to secure factory housing
links.evidence: Fei Ni proposed a radical solution: they should obtain a marriage certificate through a "fake marriage."

links.label: Falls genuinely in love and becomes his true wife
links.evidence: under the warmth of a single blanket, the two finally became a true husband and wife.

links.label: Each becomes the other's steadiest champion in pursuing their dreams
links.evidence: Fang Muyang warmly encouraged her, expressing his unwavering belief in her talent.

links.label: Fei Ni's father
links.evidence: bringing a portion of braised pork from the factory canteen to her father, Fei Mingde.

links.label: Fei Ni's mother
links.evidence: her mother, Wu Baoying, pointed out his lack of a job and a home

links.label: Fei Ni's older brother
links.evidence: volunteering for the Great Northern Wilderness so she could take their mother's job at the factory.

links.label: Childhood sweethearts who marry
links.evidence: After a heartfelt speech from Fei Ting promising to cherish Lin Mei more than anyone else, the couple celebrated a joyous wedding.

links.label: Fang Muyang's sister
links.evidence: his sister, Fang Mujing, arrived.

links.label: Marries pragmatically for political protection and career advancement
links.evidence: He admitted pragmatically that she wasn't his "best" option socially, but he chose her anyway.

links.label: Haunted by being a stand-in for Qu Hua's late love, Yan
links.evidence: Realizing she was merely a substitute for Qu Hua's late ex-girlfriend—whom she strikingly resembled—Mujing was heartbroken.

links.label: Grows into deep, genuine love
links.evidence: He declares his true love for her and formally says goodbye to his past.

links.label: Estranged mother, hurt by Mujing's public break with the family
links.evidence: Fang Mujing makes the difficult decision to formally cut ties with her parents

links.label: Mother and daughter finally reconcile
links.evidence: Mu Shanhe eventually reached out to Mujing, returning an old mirror... The mother and daughter finally reconciled.

links.label: His father
links.evidence: he has an emotional reunion with his parents, Fang Qingyuan and Mu Shanhe.

links.label: His mother
links.evidence: he has an emotional reunion with his parents, Fang Qingyuan and Mu Shanhe.

links.label: Brothers-in-law
links.evidence: Qu Hua introduced himself as a doctor from a military family, noting that his grandfather was a Red Army veteran

links.label: Forge a deep bond working side by side during earthquake relief
links.evidence: they worked tirelessly by day and found brief moments at night to gaze at the full moon, sharing their quiet longing for their wives.

links.label: Her son
links.evidence: Ye Feng, Xu Hongqi's handsome son and the star forward of the factory's basketball team

links.label: Pursues her as a suitor but is rejected in favor of Fang Muyang
links.evidence: Ye Feng was devastated and begged his mother for help.

links.label: Marries her, then divorces after her scheming affair
links.evidence: The two finalized their divorce at the subdistrict office shortly after.

links.label: Seduces her with promises of a transfer, then betrays her
links.evidence: Chen immediately betrayed Ling Yi, claiming he had no relationship with her and that she had been the one seducing him for a job transfer.

links.label: Long-running rival at the factory who repeatedly tries to expose and sabotage her
links.evidence: Alongside a coworker named Feng Lin, Ms. Xu scrutinized Fei Ni's latest thought report, accusing her of using overly sophisticated words

links.label: Boyfriend who dumps her once he graduates college
links.evidence: she intended to recommend Fei Ni for university instead of Feng's boyfriend, Wang Defa.

links.label: Blackmails her into surrendering her housing unit by threatening to expose her past scandal
links.evidence: as long as she never troubled Fei Ni again, he would ensure his "memories" of her past stayed forgotten.

links.label: Close friends since youth
links.evidence: Fei Ni's close friend, Lin Mei, paid her a visit

links.label: Siblings whose trust is strained by his gambling debts and theft
links.evidence: Lin Mei grew furious when her brother claimed he only took the extra work to pay her back, reminding him that the money he was "returning" was actually money he had stolen from their parents.

links.label: Nephew who reveals the family's scheme to marry her off for connections
links.evidence: he overheard her nephew, Lin Jianshe, revealing that the family wanted Lin Mei to marry someone with better connections to help her brother's career.

links.label: Favored by Lin Mei's mother, leaving Lin Mei to do all the housework
links.evidence: Her mother favored her sister-in-law, Aihong, leaving Lin Mei to do all the household chores after her shift at the supply cooperative.

links.label: Father who repeatedly rejects Fei Ting for lacking a stable job
links.evidence: Lin Mei's parents set a hard line: they will only consider the marriage once Fei Ting secures a stable job.

links.label: Mother who looks down on Fei Ting's prospects
links.evidence: Lin Mei's mother is dismissive of Fei Ting because he lacks a stable job, boasting about a bus driver named Chen Yunguo

links.label: Family friend and mentor who opens doors for his career
links.evidence: he visited an old family friend, Fu Boquan, at an editorial office. Fu Boquan offered him a spot in a two-month editor training course

links.label: Artistic mentor whose demand for cliché revisions clashes with his devotion to authenticity
links.evidence: Mr. Yuan criticizes his latest comic draft for being too crowded and lacking a clear protagonist.

links.label: Reconciles and offers him a new collaboration, which he declines for his independence
links.evidence: Yuan offered him a chance to return to the publishing house to collaborate on a series of novels... However, Muyang declined.

links.label: Fellow illustrator and reporter at the newspaper
links.evidence: he ran into Liao, who was interning as a reporter, but he politely noted that their work likely wouldn't overlap.

links.label: Teaches him catering on the side, and takes the fall with him when caught moonlighting
links.evidence: a terrified Chef Li pleaded for his job, citing his responsibility as his family's sole provider.

links.label: Section Chief who eventually secures him a proper cadre post
links.evidence: Chief Wang fulfilled her promise and helped secure Fei Ting a position as a regular cadre in the Publicity Department

links.label: Factory director who repeatedly blocks and grants her university recommendation
links.evidence: Ms. Xu remained critical.

links.label: Comes to respect her selflessness after the earthquake
links.evidence: Xu Hongqi observed a profound change in Fei Ni... fueled by her deep devotion to Fang Muyang.

links.label: Assistant who publicly denounces her former mentor for personal advancement
links.evidence: Feng Lin publicly denounced her, accusing her of using her influence to secure a position for Ling Yi.

links.label: Research mentor who champions her career, including a path to study in Germany
links.evidence: Professor Wu informed her that she was the top candidate for a two-year stint to study in Germany.

links.label: Ex-boyfriend who abandoned her for his own career, now resentful of her success
links.evidence: Liu Wei, who once left her to protect his career prospects due to her family background, is resentful of her presence on the project team.

links.label: Skeptical mother-in-law, questioning his stability and prospects
links.evidence: her mother, Wu Baoying, pointed out his lack of a job and a home

links.label: Comes to appreciate her son-in-law's talent and devotion
links.evidence: Seeing his talent and dedication, Fei Ni's mother finally began to appreciate her son-in-law.

links.label: Father-in-law won over by his sincerity, skill, and devotion to Fei Ni
links.evidence: Fang Muyang's sincerity and intelligence eventually convinced Mr. Fei to support the union.

links.label: New Vice Director who reassigns her from leadership to the shop floor
links.evidence: Xu Hongqi was reassigned from her administrative post back to the production line in Workshop One.

links.label: Later vindicates her against false accusations of nepotism
links.evidence: He vindicated Xu Hongqi, recalling her past as a model worker who could manage a dozen looms with ease.

links.label: Disbands his basketball team and pushes him into ordinary labor
links.evidence: Left with only the cafeteria or gate security as options, Ye Feng turns to his mother.

links.label: Grants him a fast-track to permanent employment as a cook after his honesty is rewarded
links.evidence: Vice Director Chen of the Jiangcheng No. 1 Textile Factory officially announced that Fei Ting would be given a fast-track to permanent employment as a cook.
